purpose: Define which timestamps may establish historical public availability for predictor use. This policy does not make current AVALL rows historically admissible by itself.

rules.verified: Requires an explicit dated public release/publication artifact or archived official snapshot establishing the record/field was public no later than available_at.
rules.bounded: Use when evidence only establishes an interval in which public availability began. Bounded rows are excluded from strict backtests unless a separately preregistered conservative interval rule makes the entire interval admissible for the cutoff.
rules.unknown: Default when historical public release timing cannot be established. Unknown rows are excluded from strict PIT backtests.

timestamps_not_accepted_as_publication_e: a field being present in today's AVALL database

current_adapter_behavior.approval_date: outcome/admin metadata only; never copied to available_at
current_adapter_behavior.last_change: revision/admin metadata only; never copied to available_at
current_adapter_behavior.explicit_publication_timestamp: may populate available_at only when source semantics establish that it is a public-release timestamp
current_adapter_behavior.missing_publication_evidence: available_at remains null and PIT status remains unknown

field_level_warning: A source-level release date does not prove every modern field was present in that historical release. Where the backtest uses a specific field, archived/versioned evidence must establish that field's historical presence or the field remains PIT-unknown.

current_g3_effect.reason: The source policy is now explicit, but record-level and field-level historical availability coverage has not yet been established for the predictor universe.

next_step: Build versioned NTSB release/snapshot records with immutable official or archived locators, release dates, covered tables/fields, and derived record-level PIT statuses; exclude unknown/bounded rows from the strict backtest until admissibility is proven.
